questions.question: How has the meaning of art changed over time, and why is it important in society?
questions.solution_html:
• How has the meaning of art changed over time, and why is it important in society? / [CO1]
  • Art is a visual object or experience consciously created through an expression of skill or
  • imagination. Art can be defined as the creation of something through a person’s creativity . [2
  • marks for mean ing and definition of Art ]. The meaning of art changed over time can be
  • explained with the five Philosophies of Art such as Mimesis (imitation or reflection of real life),
  • Expression (expression of the artist’ s emotions and thoughts), Formalism (design and aesthetic
  • qualities of the artwork ), Institutional theory (accepted and recognized by the art world ),
  • Postmodernism (no single or fixed meaning in art ) (1 mark) each for explaining the five
  • philosophies]. The purpose of art in society: Source of Aesthetic Pleasure, For communicating
  • complex ideas and emotions, Tool for social and political critique and change, For religious and
  • spiritual practices and expressions (1 mark) each for any three points].
